utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa, I’ve been telling folks Noah’s helping with the repair drive, and if I hear the time again I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — please let folks know the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and we’re still collecting tool drop-offs through Friday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Rosa — I’ll let people know it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll repeat that tool drop-offs are still being collected through Friday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it straightforward: 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple, I’ll manage the signup sheet, and whoever’s on tools can handle check-in and patch kits.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds better, but I’d still feel easier if we confirm who’s definitely bringing tools and whether parking on Maple will stay manageable once people start arriving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Fair point—let’s confirm one person for tools and patch kits before we start, and I’ll ask Opal to keep the 10 a.m. Maple note updated so we can watch parking and adjust if it gets crowded.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll bring the tools over and leave them by the signup table if you’re running late. I probably won’t stay long, but I do want to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps, thanks — from what I’ve heard they’re still collecting through Friday, so leaving them by the signup table should be fine. I’m still piecing things together, but I can bring those gloves and an extension cord too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, thanks. I’ll keep it simple and drop mine off there too, then head out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we’re set for Saturday at 10 at the community garage on Maple—I’ve got tool check-in and patch kits, and Eli’s handling the signup sheet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that, Oren? I heard it was moved to Sunday at the community center, and I want to know if Mara’s still bringing the socket set and Ben’s still bringing the bike chains and pump.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—no, I only know the plan as Saturday at 10 at the community garage on Maple, with me on tool check-in and patch kits and Eli on the signup sheet; I don’t know anything about a move or Mara and Ben’s gear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take the porch rails Saturday morning—are the fence panels and shed roof already covered?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Fence panels are covered—Gus is still set for 9 with the drill and socket set. I’m still checking quietly on the shed roof and tool gaps, and I’ll let you know once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll plan on the porch rails Saturday morning. If the shed roof still needs a hand or extra tools, send me a note.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the exact Sunday timing, but if the repair drive lands in the middle of the day, Faye should be able to help around her school runs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That helps—if Sunday settles around midday, having Faye there between school runs could be really useful. I’ll pass that along once the timing’s pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks—I’m watching for the Sunday time from Mara, and if it lands after lunch I’ll try to slot Faye into that middle-of-the-day window.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there by 9 with the drill and socket set, and we can start on those loose fence panels first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Gus — we still need help on the fence Saturday morning, and I’m confirming the exact start time with the organizer now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—keep me posted on the exact time, and I’ll still plan on bringing the drill and socket set for those fence panels.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you hear who’s still short on lumber, tarps, or hand tools, send them my way and I’ll add it to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—right now I know Gus has the drill and socket set, but we still need confirmation on tarps and paint coverage. Can you note those as open and keep lumber flagged too until Hana gets back to me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, I’ve got tarps and paint coverage marked open, and I’ll keep lumber flagged until Hana gets back to you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve still got the repair drive down for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple, with Bo’s timing as the only thing pending.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That lines up well — Faye can help in that window, and the solid confirms I’ve got are Mara with the socket set and Ben bringing spare chains and a pump.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’m adding Faye in that window, plus Mara with the socket set and Ben with the spare chains and pump; I still have Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community garage on Maple unless Bo shifts it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still helping with the repair drive—I just keep blanking on the time, so if you’ve heard it, tell me again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, and I’m telling everyone, so bring a neighbor if you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—Saturday, 10 to 2 at the community center. Thanks, Quinn; I’ll be there, and I’ll see if I can bring someone along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, I’m still set for 10 a.m. on Maple with the tools and patch kits, and I’ll start on the shed roof Saturday morning with my ladder.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I can be there between 10 and 2:30 and help in the middle of the day, as long as I’m clear of school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works great, Faye—swing by when you can, and we’ll have you jump in on the shed roof once the morning rush settles.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m getting there a little late, but I’ll check the signup table first and pass along any shortages I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—that helps. We’re still using 10 at the Maple garage for now, and I’ll update you once Mara confirms the exact times and volunteer needs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll head to the signup table when I get there and let Cleo know if I hear anyone’s short on tools, lumber, or tarps.
